name: Martha Nussbaum
shortBio: American philosopher who bridged Aristotelian virtue ethics, Stoic moral psychology, and global justice by co-developing the Capabilities Approach alongside Amartya Sen.
centralQuestion: What central human capabilities must every political constitution secure so that each person—including women, disabled persons, and non-human animals—can live a life worthy of dignity?

keyWorks.title: The Fragility of Goodness
keyWorks.description: Examines Greek tragedy, Plato, and Aristotle on moral luck, vulnerability, and the limits of rational self-sufficiency.

keyWorks.title: Women and Human Development: The Capabilities Approach
keyWorks.description: Articulates ten central human capabilities as universal constitutional thresholds for global gender justice.

keyWorks.title: Frontiers of Justice
keyWorks.description: Critiques Rawlsian social contract theory for neglecting disability, global poverty, and non-human animal entitlements.
